sourceEntry.note: This stages exactly the original names in the planned source facade; package manifests, root API and baselines are unchanged.

items: actual package exports/manifests/declarations and packed consumers
formal cross-platform/physical touch and Native composition
formal production performance and final candidate/release gates

problem: Applications lacked reusable split allocation and tab page lifecycle, requiring handwritten sizing, input and focus management.
method: Composites in gui-layout lower to the existing Grid/Flex core, borrow page objects, detach inactive branches and reuse the existing input/focus/theme and region invalidation contracts.
conclusion: Original G08 runtime and production example verified. The five original names are staged in the planned source facade (11/11); package/public admission, cross-platform and final release qualification remain with G13.

usage.layout: Attach one GuiLayoutBinding to the GuiRoot; add panel.element and size it through binding.setStyle. Nested panels reuse that same delegate.
usage.split: axis selects left/right or top/bottom. ratio is preferred [0,1]; effectiveRatio reports solved allocation. Numeric minima overflow rather than shrink below the contract; a parent scroll container may own that overflow.
usage.tabs: Pass the existing guiSystem.focus; pages own their business objects. activate/remove/close/setPageVisible/move manage page lifecycle. Inactive content is detached without changing its visible flag.
usage.serialization: Use each composite serialize()/restore() in the application save envelope; restore requires the same page IDs. The existing haiyue.gui v1 schema is unchanged and does not automatically encode these composite layout records.
usage.cleanup: Call dispose() on each composite and the shared binding. Borrowed contents, image/GPU sources and theme resources remain application-owned.
